title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Job description We at UDS family of 55K+ workforce is a leading, focused, and integrated business services platform in India offering integrated facilities management services and other services to our customers with a pan India presence. Our portfolio of services has also evolved over the years to cater to the needs of diverse customer segments across a range of sectors including FMCG, manufacturing and engineering, banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI), healthcare, information technology / information technology enabled services (IT / ITeS), automobiles, logistics and warehousing, airports, ports, infrastructure and retail, among others. 
 Job Summary HR Executive | Power / Manufacturing Industry We are looking for an HR Executive to manage day-to-day HR operations and employee support at our industrial site. The role involves employee relations, attendance & leave management, manpower coordination, HR MIS, joining & exit formalities, contract labour compliance, and employee welfare activities. 
 Female candidates preferred. Candidates with 2+ years of experience in HR Operations / Employee Relations, particularly from Power, Manufacturing, or Industrial environments, are preferred. 
 Employee HR Support & HR Helpdesk Attendance & Leave Management Women Workforce Management HR MIS & Manpower Reports Joining & Exit Management Night Shift Officers / CLs Observation Reports Gate Pass Management Monthly Contract Labour Management Audit Employee Welfare & Grievance Handling 
 Preferred Profile 
 Minimum 2 years of experience in HR Operations / Employee Relations Female candidates preferred Experience in Power / Manufacturing / Industrial environments preferred Good knowledge of attendance, manpower management & HR MIS Strong coordination and communication skills

Key Skills: HR Generalist Activities,HR Coordination,Employee Orientation,Grievance Handling,Joining Formalities,Corporate HR,Attendance Management,Exit Formalities
